confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Cartagena's tourist pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain; accommodation anchors are less certain because high-season (July) hotel rates vary widely by neighborhood, and the figures are meant to include the 19% IVA and typical tourist fees. Cocktail and wine were set using the local relationship to beer (roughly 3x a beer), since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. FX: the 0.6947 figure comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not read directly. That summary also showed 0.6955 for 15 October, so the 16 October value may be provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Colombia's high-season coastal and heritage tourism pricing, benchmarked against other major Colombian visitor cities such as Medellin and Santa Marta, with a premium for the Old City and Getsemani areas where visitors stay and dine.
